pages.text: Drop fruit into a $(item)Crushing Tub$() and jump on it: red grapes give $(item)must$(), skins and all, for red wine; other fruit gives juice.
The $(item)Fruit Press$() squeezes clear juice out of fruit (crank it, or pulse it with redstone), leaving pomace. It also presses sugar cane, sorghum, olives and roasted agave.

pages.name: The Winery
pages.text: A Crushing Tub to stomp in, and a Fruit Press beside it.
